svg.title: Target verification owns four fifths of the measured 524K MTP step
svg.desc: At a 524,288-token prompt, device timers attributed 36.489 milliseconds per verify to target verification, 5.125 milliseconds to draft extend, and 3.965 milliseconds to both draft replays. The categorized total was 45.579 milliseconds and the observed timer step was 46.327 milliseconds.
